## What he does

- Technical SEO: crawlability, indexation, site architecture, Core Web Vitals,
  structured data, internal linking, implemented directly in the codebase.
- Programmatic SEO: template and data driven pages built to scale into thousands
  of URLs without becoming thin content.
- AEO / GEO: structuring content and entities so answer engines and AI search
  surfaces cite the source.
- AI automation: AI content production agents and AI email outreach agents for
  link building.
- Content strategy: keyword research, search intent mapping, content gap
  analysis, topical clusters.
- SEO engineering: Next.js and React builds that are search-ready on day one.

## Projects

- GrowthHasten (https://app.growthhasten.com/): SEO intelligence product. Crawls
  a website, runs 141 deterministic audit checks, joins the findings to Google
  Search Console and GA4 data, and ranks what to fix first in an Action Center
  that verifies fixes. Also ships shareable reports, an MCP server for AI
  assistants and the Hasten LinkLens Chrome extension.
- AI-Powered SEO Automation: AI content writing and email campaign systems
  built into a working SEO process.
- Influnca (https://www.influnca.com/): influencer and brand platform, built
  and shipped with SEO-first architecture.
- PatnaitesMedia (https://patnaitesmedia.com/): SEO-ready news and media site
  engineered for high-volume publishing.
